title: Yellowed Wood Fired Portuguese Chicken Bake
description: A nutty and snappy weeknight Portuguese dish featuring freshly chopped parsley, this wood-fired bake is a delicious and easy meal option, egg-free friendly and made in a fondue pot.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the chicken mixture to the fondue pot and bake for 20 minutes.
Stir in lemon juice and chicken broth, then continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.
Sprinkle parsley over the top of the chicken and bake for 5 more minutes.
Remove the fondue pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
